shortDescription: Amlak Finance PJSC is a specialized real estate financier providing Sharia-compliant home financing solutions in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Established in 2000, Amlak Finance offers Islamic property financing products including Ijarah, Murabaha, and Istithmari. It serves retail home buyers and commercial property investors across the UAE.
address: Office No. 1803, Grosvenor Business Tower, Barsha Heights, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Amplify Dubai is an integrated marketing, design, and digital advertising agency based in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Amplify provides marketing and advertising services covering brand strategy, web design, SEO, social media management, and experiential digital campaigns for regional and global clients.
address: Office 801, The Dome Tower, Cluster N, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Digital Agency Network - Amplify Dubai Profile

notes: Original directory listed area as Business Bay; registered entity is Amplify Marketing Agency DMCC located in The Dome Tower, JLT. No advertised careers or public vacancies were found.

shortDescription: Audi Volkswagen Middle East FZE is the regional headquarters overseeing operations for Volkswagen Group brands across the Middle East.
whatTheyDo: Based at Dubai Airport Freezone, AVME manages sales, aftersales, network development, and brand strategy for Audi, Volkswagen, Bentley, Lamborghini, and Škoda across regional dealership networks.

sources.title: Gulf News - Volkswagen Group Middle East Operations

notes: Original directory listed area as Downtown; regional headquarters is located in Dubai Airport Freezone (DAFZA). Offers internship opportunities for fresh graduates, but currently lists no active public vacancies.

shortDescription: AVA GROUP CO DMCC is an international holding company involved in multimodal freight transport, logistics, and trading operations based in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Operating internationally across Dubai, Guangzhou, and Tehran, AVA GROUP CO DMCC provides air, sea, and land cargo transportation, customs clearance, and commercial distribution of electronics and consumer goods.

sources.title: Australian Taxation Office - Class Ruling CR 2021/83 regarding Ava Risk Group and Ava Global DMCC

notes: Multiple entities operate under the AVA Group name in Dubai, including AVA GROUP CO DMCC in JLT/DMCC and the former logistics firm Ava Global DMCC (divested by Australia's Ava Risk Group in 2021). No public job listings or university recruitment programmes were found.

shortDescription: BAC Middle East was a long-standing recruitment consultancy in the UAE that has permanently closed down.
whatTheyDo: Established in 1979 as one of the first professional recruitment agencies in Dubai, BAC Middle East provided recruitment and staffing services across multiple commercial sectors until permanently ceasing operations.

sources.title: Naukrigulf Company Profile - BAC Middle East

notes: Company has permanently ceased operations and closed down; official notice on bacme.com confirms closure and database deletion. Directory listing of Business Bay is obsolete.

shortDescription: Bahri is the national shipping company of Saudi Arabia, maintaining regional ship management and commercial shipping operations in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Bahri operates a large global maritime fleet encompassing crude oil tankers (VLCCs), chemicals, dry bulk, and general logistics. Its Dubai office in JLT oversees vessel technical management, fleet operations, and regional logistics support.
address: One JLT, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai, UAE
notes: Bahri (The National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia, headquartered in Riyadh with regional offices in One JLT) must not be confused with the UAE-based Bahri & Mazroei Group.

shortDescription: Bahri and Mazroei Trading Company is a UAE-based distributor of commercial lighting, electrical, and building engineering products.
whatTheyDo: Founded in 1968, BMTC supplies architectural and commercial lighting solutions, electrical components, and water management equipment to major construction, industrial, and infrastructure developments across the UAE.
address: Al Khabaisi, Deira, P.O. Box 1247, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Bayt.com Company Profile - Bahri & Mazroei Trading Company

notes: Original directory listed area as Dubai Internet City; group headquarters is located in Al Khabaisi, Deira, Dubai. BMTC is distinct from the Saudi shipping company Bahri.

shortDescription: BASF FZE is the regional headquarters for multinational chemical manufacturer BASF across the Middle East and Egypt.
whatTheyDo: Operating in the UAE since the 1970s, BASF supplies performance materials, industrial chemicals, coatings, and nutrition ingredients to regional manufacturers, while managing technical support and supply chain distribution from Dubai.
address: Tower B, JAFZA One, Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai, UAE
notes: Original directory listed area as Dubai Internet City; BASF FZE regional hub is located in JAFZA One (Jebel Ali Free Zone), Dubai. Construction chemicals division was previously divested to MBCC Group.

shortDescription: Bausch + Lomb is a global eye health company supplying contact lenses, ophthalmic surgical devices, and ocular pharmaceuticals in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Bausch + Lomb provides eye care products across vision care, surgical equipment, and ophthalmic medicines. Its Dubai-based team handles commercial marketing, regulatory affairs, and distribution to hospitals and optical retailers.

sources.title: Tanqeeb Job Search - Bausch + Lomb UAE

notes: Original directory listed area as Downtown; operations in Dubai function primarily as regional commercial, marketing, and regulatory offices.
